paragraphs: The Champi Warrior is a mobile infantry unit built for scouting, raiding, and putting pressure on exposed enemies. Its protection against arrows helps it close with foot archers, while its attacks threaten siege weapons and buildings. It can also build Outposts to watch important ground.

Four civilizations bring different strengths to this unit: cheaper recruitment, greater endurance, faster movement, or faster attacks. We will compare their fully upgraded Champi Warriors against the same opponents, balancing army sizes by resource cost and population efficiency.
